Subject: Benchmark plan & acceptance criteria for Redwood onboarding

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier — QuickPay is targeting a production switch for payments routing the week of Apr 12, and we need Redwood's benchmark evidence and a short acceptance checklist to present to our infra team.

High level ask: can Redwood run a full load run and provide the p50/p95/p99 latency contours plus throughput curve for our expected workload (burst up to 900 RPS, baseline 300 RPS) and confirm tail latency SLAs. Our internal target is p95 < 120ms for gen requests at 512 tokens.

Can you share a test plan, the test window you prefer, and any artifacts you will produce? If helpful I can loop in our ops mailbox (ops+load@quickpay.com) for artifact ingestion.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Director, Platform Engineering
QuickPay

Thanks Ben — technical notes from my side:

Test harness config (attached: loadtest.yml) — highlights:
- Client emulator will use a mixture of prompt lengths to match your production distribution: 60% short (<=64 tokens), 30% medium (65–256), 10% long (257–512).
- Payload concurrency will simulate connection reuse and KV cache warmup — important to reproduce latencies for long-context requests.
- Ramp: 0 -> 300 RPS over 10m, hold 30m; spike to 900 RPS for 5m; cool down 15m.
- Metrics exported: per-request start/finish timestamps, model variant, GPU util, memory pressure, request error codes.

Required from QuickPay for a clean run:
- Test API key (read-only) or allowlist IP range for our runners.
- Any custom request headers (tenant id) we should stamp for observability.
- Confirmation of tokenization/profile for your production model (we will use the same checkpoint).

I'll provision a dedicated test queue and will post a Grafana dashboard link once the run is scheduled. We will also capture raw csv (qp_load_results_20270405.csv) and an automated summary (p50/p95/p99 + error rate).

Attachment: loadtest.yml

Hi Elena — I scheduled the canary + full run as Ben proposed. Summary below and quick checklist (attached: canary-checklist.md):

Schedule (US-PST):
- Canary: Apr 5 02:00–02:30 (small traffic, smoke checks)
- Full run: Apr 5 02:35–05:30 (ramp, steady, spike, cool-down)

Acceptance gates we will use live:

Who owns what:
- QuickPay (ops+load@quickpay.com): confirm IP allowlist or provide test key.
- Dev (redwood): execute harness and post Grafana.
